rule: Keep only canonical griz PHOT rows
reason: Frozen feature representation uses griz only; separator '-' rows and SDSS u/U/G/R/I/Z auxiliary tokens are not compact-feature input.
Non-positive uncertainty rows are SNANA structural/separator rows unless audit shows otherwise.

rule: Retain negative and zero FLUXCAL measurements
reason: Both releases are forced-photometry products. Flux sign is not an epoch-quality criterion.

rule: No S/N threshold at quality-mask stage
reason: The S/N >= 3 rule belongs to the already frozen compact-feature builder, not release-quality filtering.
No threshold may be introduced unless release documentation explicitly marks measurements invalid.

rule: Do not reject PHOTFLAG values by empirical frequency
reason: Bit frequencies alone do not establish quality semantics. Only release-documented invalid-image/measurement bits may be excluded.
